heroHeadline: Al-Murrah Massacre Toll Confirmed at 60 Civilians; Kabum Drone Strike Kills 12 in South Darfur; Lean Season Emergency Deepens
heroSubtitle: The confirmed death toll from the RSF's Eid al-Adha assault on villages west of Bara, North Kordofan has reached 60 civilians — making it the deadliest single RSF ground atrocity in Kordofan in 2026. Sudan's Foreign Ministry condemned the massacre June 2 and urged UNSC action. A drone struck civilians near Kabum in South Darfur on June 1 killing 12, with attribution disputed between SAF and RSF. Sudan PM Kamil Idris inspected Port Sudan International Airport on June 2, issuing directives for infrastructure expansion as Qatar Airways prepares to launch a Doha–Port Sudan route (July 2). Sudan's June–August lean season emergency is now fully underway: IPC projects 28.9 million acutely hungry at peak, with IPC Phase 5 famine active in El Fasher and Kadugli and 20+ areas at critical risk. The 2026 UN humanitarian appeal remains only ~20% funded as access routes are cut by the RSF-closed Adre border crossing, rainy-season road blockages, and ongoing drone warfare that has killed 880+ civilians in just four months. Day 1144 of the SAF-RSF war with no ceasefire.
